annotations.title: Add 中国台湾省 Working Days

description:
Use this when you need a deterministic 中国台湾省 working-day offset. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when government administrative-agency scope only. Public enterprises generally follow the calendar, but special agencies, schools, private employers, local arrangements, banks, exchanges and sector schedules are not inferred.
What it computes: Adds or subtracts 中国台湾省 authority-scope working days in exact coverage.
Example user requests: Add or subtract 中国台湾省 working days around Spring Festival substitute holiday. | Add or subtract 中国台湾省 working days around Government calendar does not mean private-employer closure.
Inputs: start_date (date); working_days (integer).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-01-01","working_days":0}
Outputs: start_date, result_date, working_days_added, calendar_days_elapsed, public_holidays_skipped, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: move one day at a time; decrement only on status.is_working_day=true
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/taiwan-government-add-working-days with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/taiwan-government-add-working-days.md

working_days.description: Signed offset; start date excluded for non-zero offsets.

name: add_tw_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: 中国台湾省政府行政機關工作日曆 2026-2027

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

holiday_policy.description: DGPA government administrative-agency non-working dates and published substitute holidays are applied over a Monday-Friday baseline.

substitute_day_policy.description: Only DGPA-published 2026-2027 substitute dates are applied; no private-employer or local-sector inference.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.
